metadata.title: Switch across the block
metadata.subtitle: Watch two receiving options develop around the ball.
metadata.subtitleZh: 观察持球者周围的两种接应选择。
metadata.source: Independently authored synthetic tactical boards and bounded kinematic simulation; no recorded match tracking or third-party scene source.
metadata.seedUsage: Provenance identifier; this authored version has no random motion.

A1.name: Goalkeeper
A1.rationale: Move behind the rest defence and offer a safe reset.

A2.name: Near-side full-back
A2.rationale: Support outside the ball, then overlap or recover behind the winger.

A3.name: Near-side centre-back
A3.rationale: Start circulation and advance the rest defence after release.

A4.name: Far-side centre-back
A4.rationale: Keep the central safety line and balance the ball-side centre-back.

A5.name: Far-side full-back
A5.rationale: Provide a weak-side outlet while retaining recovery depth.

A6.name: Holding midfielder
A6.rationale: Receive from defence, carry, and remain available behind the attack.

A7.name: Near-side winger
A7.rationale: Adjust width and timing to offer a direct receiving route.

A8.name: Far-side midfielder
A8.rationale: Offer a second passing angle and support switches of play.

A9.name: Centre-forward
A9.rationale: Occupy the centre-backs, check to the ball, and attack the next line.

A10.name: Attacking midfielder
A10.rationale: Provide a third-player option between the lines.

A11.name: Far-side winger
A11.rationale: Hold useful width, then arrive as the ball crosses the pitch.

B1.name: Defending goalkeeper
B1.rationale: Adjust the set position to the ball angle and depth.

B2.name: Near-side full-back
B2.rationale: Manage the winger and overlapping full-back without abandoning the line.

B3.name: Near-side centre-back
B3.rationale: Cover behind the full-back and track the centre-forward.

B4.name: Far-side centre-back
B4.rationale: Protect the centre and hand over runners across the line.

B5.name: Far-side full-back
B5.rationale: Narrow toward the ball, then engage a switch to the far winger.

B6.name: Near-side holding midfielder
B6.rationale: Press the carrier or screen the direct pass into the front line.

B7.name: Near-side wide midfielder
B7.rationale: Recover with the overlapping full-back and close the outside route.

B8.name: Far-side central midfielder
B8.rationale: Cover the pressing midfielder and contest the second option.

B9.name: First-line presser
B9.rationale: Press circulation, then recover into the central return lane.

B10.name: Second-line presser
B10.rationale: Screen the pivot and recover as the ball goes beyond the first line.

B11.name: Far-side wide midfielder
B11.rationale: Track the weak-side outlet and narrow with the defensive block.
